summary.notes: Packet HR-002 needs field correction and stronger evidence before it can be kept as a security finding.

finding_reviews.reason: Reachability: the packet's cited entry point at src/Api/Webhooks/Handlers/WebhookHandler.php:19 is not packet-locally connected to this AJAX handler; the actual reachable hook in scope is the wp_ajax registration at src/Admin/Notices/AddFormNotice.php:28. Authorization: handle_ajax_action() has no capability check, but execution is still limited to authenticated AJAX requests with a valid nonce, and nonce delivery is gated by should_render() and admin-screen conditions. Dataflow: sanitized $_POST['choice'] at src/Admin/Notices/AddFormNotice.php:45 only selects between a one-week transient write at line 59 and a fixed redirect string at line 66. Impact: packet-local evidence supports, at most, global dismissal of an onboarding notice, not subscriber privilege escalation or a meaningful security state change. Missing evidence: the worker has not shown that a subscriber can actually obtain the localized nonce on the whitelisted screens, nor that this notice toggle has concrete security impact.
required_changes: Remove src/Api/Webhooks/Handlers/WebhookHandler.php:19 as the entry point for this packet unless a packet-local trace to AddFormNotice::init() is provided; the in-scope registration is src/Admin/Notices/AddFormNotice.php:28.

Do not describe the issue as 'subscriber privilege escalation' without evidence that a subscriber or equivalent low-privileged role can reach a whitelisted screen and receive the nonce localized at src/Admin/Notices/AddFormNotice.php:155.
Narrow the authorization precondition to an authenticated user with a valid notice nonce obtained from the screens allowed by src/Admin/Notices/AddFormNotice.php:103-117.

Narrow the impact statement to the concrete packet-local effects: setting the notice-dismiss transient at src/Admin/Notices/AddFormNotice.php:59 or returning the fixed redirect URL at src/Admin/Notices/AddFormNotice.php:66.

counter_evidence.detail: This abstract webhook handler only registers init_hooks on init; the packet provides no packet-local path from this anchor to AddFormNotice::handle_ajax_action(), so the current entry-point anchor is mismapped.
The handler is registered only on wp_ajax_hostinger_reach_add_form_notice_action, not on a wp_ajax_nopriv_* hook, so the route is authenticated-only.
check_ajax_referer(self::NOTICE_ACTION, 'nonce') must pass before either branch executes.
should_render() restricts notice rendering to a fixed set of admin screens, so nonce distribution is not shown as universally available to all logged-in roles.
The nonce is localized only when enqueue_notice_assets() runs, which depends on should_render(); packet-local evidence does not prove a subscriber can obtain it.
The dismiss branch only sets the hostinger_reach_add_form_notice_dismissed transient for one week and returns wp_send_json_success().
The success branch only returns a fixed admin.php?page=hostinger-reach&addForm=1 redirect string; it does not change plugin settings, capabilities, or stored credentials.

missing_evidence: File:line or reproducible evidence that a subscriber or equivalent low-privileged role can reach one of the screens whitelisted at src/Admin/Notices/AddFormNotice.php:103-110 and receive the nonce localized at src/Admin/Notices/AddFormNotice.php:155.
Packet-local evidence that the transient written at src/Admin/Notices/AddFormNotice.php:59 causes a measurable security consequence beyond hiding this onboarding notice.
A packet-local trace connecting the claimed entry-point anchor src/Api/Webhooks/Handlers/WebhookHandler.php:19 to AddFormNotice::init() if that anchor is to remain in the packet.

suggested_field_corrections.auth_required: authenticated user with a valid nonce from the AddFormNotice admin UI
suggested_field_corrections.vuln_type: Missing capability check on authenticated AJAX notice action
suggested_field_corrections.claimed_impact: Global dismissal of the Add Form admin notice for one week; success branch only returns a fixed admin redirect URL.
